name: Gaze + Voice
summary: Gaze narrows the candidate set while voice specifies the final intended item.
howItWorks: Look toward the target group and speak a target name or ordinal.
advantages: Highly ambiguous scenes, especially when targets overlap.
limitations: Depends on reliable speech recognition and concise labels.
